---
applyTo: **/*.al
description: 'Naming rules for AL code files.'
---

# Naming Rules

1. PascalCase for objects (tables, pages, codeunits, etc.) and their members (fields, actions, procedures, etc.), variables, procedures and constants.
2. Prefix every object with "FMS" (e.g., "FMSMyTable", "FMSMyPage").
3. File name pattern: FMS<ObjectName>.<ObjectType>.al (e.g., FMSMyTable.Table.al, FMSMyPage.Page.al)
